verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Unreal's C++, Python, and Blueprint scripting surfaces but contains no mention of an official language server (LSP), generated typed stubs, or any machine-tooling API definitions that a coding agent's editor could attach to for completions/diagnostics/navigation. The probe items even note the ecosystem is generally poorly machine-readable (no official MCP, docs not markdown-accessible, gated repo), reinforcing the absence rather than filling it.
